// =============================================================================
// Design notes (P3 disclosures):
//   * Buffer: two slots (head + skid). in_ready is a register (A2); the two
//     slots are the minimum that keeps II=1 on open flow and loses nothing
//     when the consumer stalls in the cycle a word is accepted (A3/T5).

//     cycle the word is accepted, and frozen into the buffer. Configuration
//     is therefore sampled with its word (A5) by construction.
//   * Exact product (F5): 33-bit signed (x - offset) * 16-bit signed scale,
//     carried at full 49-bit width; saturation happens only after rounding.
//   * Rounding (F4): magnitude-domain, round bit = mag[truncate-1], which is
//     ties-away on the magnitude and hence ties-away on the signed value.
//   * Normaliser (F7): priority-encoded leading-zero count over the 10-bit
//     subnormal mantissa.

module sdp_requant (
    input  logic         clk,
    input  logic         rst_n,
    input  logic [63:0]  in_data,
    input  logic         in_valid,
    output logic         in_ready,
    input  logic [ 1:0]  cfg_precision,
    input  logic [31:0]  cfg_offset,
    input  logic [15:0]  cfg_scale,
    input  logic [ 5:0]  cfg_truncate,
    input  logic         cfg_bypass,
    input  logic         cfg_nan_to_zero,
    output logic [127:0] out_data,
    output logic         out_valid,
    input  logic         out_ready
);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // integer lane: sat32(round_ties_away((x - offset) * scale / 2**trunc))
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function automatic logic [31:0] lane_int (
        input logic [15:0] x,
        input logic [31:0] off,
        input logic [15:0] scl,
        input logic [ 5:0] tr,
        input logic        byp
    );
        logic signed [32:0] diff;    // x - off, exact in 33 bits
        logic signed [48:0] prod;    // exact 33x16 product
        logic        [48:0] mag;     // |prod|  (< 2**46)
        logic        [63:0] magx;    // mag, zero-extended for indexing
        logic        [48:0] rmag;    // mag >> tr
        logic               rbit;    // round-up decision
        logic        [48:0] rm;      // rounded magnitude
        logic        [31:0] res;
        begin
            if (byp) begin
                res = {{16{x[15]}}, x};
            end else begin
                diff = $signed({x[15], x}) - $signed({off[31], off});
                prod = diff * $signed(scl);
                mag  = prod[48] ? (~prod + 49'd1) : prod;
                magx = {15'd0, mag};

                // round up iff bit (tr-1) of mag is set (tr==0 -> no rounding)
                rbit = (tr == 6'd0) ? 1'b0 : magx[tr - 6'd1];

                end else begin
                    res = (rm  > 49'd2147483648) ? 32'h80000000
                                                  : (~rm[31:0] + 32'd1);
                end
            end
            lane_int = res;
        end
    endfunction
